title: Question 12
passage:
The cabinet can open either way. Which side should I put the hinges on?
A. The screws are in the plastic tray. B. On the left, so the door won't block the outlet on the right. C. It was delivered without a handle.
passageZh:
櫃門可以向任一側開。我應該把鉸鏈裝在哪一側？
A. 螺絲在塑膠托盤裡。 B. 裝左側，這樣櫃門就不會擋住右邊的插座。 C. 送來時沒有門把。
